mission.Xiomara_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.bri:
We don't know how some quasimorphs remain in our reality, while the majority are always attracted by their bramfaturas. I want to say that %STATION_NAME% is simply teeming with warriors of %VICTIM_NAME%. Sensors show that they are aware of the attack and are waiting for your arrival.

Proceed methodically, do not take unnecessary risks. Kill enough and the survivors will run. Upon completion of the mission, as soon as you leave the facility, Xiomara will send her duke.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_RaiderCapture1.det:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% does not understand what it is doing. Gagtungr sleeps in the inaccessible bramfatura of the Sun. He did not give sanctions for the construction of new empires. The world of Bramfatur must continue to exist, and Feathered Masks will contribute to this.

%STATION_NAME% is in the hands of %VICTIM_NAME%. These upstarts must be forever expelled from physical reality, whose task is to be the reverse side of the real world and serve as a source of gavvakh.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Sabotage1.after: The quasimorphs of %VICTIM_NAME% at %STATION_NAME% resemble bees in a disturbed hive. The time will soon come to strike again here. <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color> are extremely pleased with our work. We received one of the artifacts as a gift from <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color>.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Sabotage1.briefing: What the sensors are showing is impossible to believe. These <color=#FFFEC1>reliquaries</color>... they are literally shining! %STATION_NAME% is swarming with quasimorphs. Show the %VICTIM_NAME% faction how humans fight. Let us prove our usefulness to <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color>.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Sabotage1.details:
Details: Xiomara has partially lifted the veil of mystery surrounding why the quasimorphs of the Feathered Masks are able to remain in physical reality for extended periods of time. They have learned to bind their energy to a special reliquary, which serves as another object of worship.

It appears that, somehow, the quasimorphs of the %VICTIM_NAME% faction have taken possession of this secret and are able to remain in our world. At %STATION_NAME%, there are reliquaries that grant them this ability. We can help the Feathered Masks if we destroy these quasimorphic artifacts.
mission.Xiomara_Shedu_Sabotage1.objectiv: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and destroy the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquaries</color> — quasimorphic artifacts resembling a statue or an obelisk.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Control1.after: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. The cargo has been received. <color=#FFFEC1>Creepy</color> creatures, but I think I'm starting to get used to them.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Control1.briefi: %VICTIM_NAME% is already attacking %STATION_NAME%. You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color>. Eliminate the attackers before they destroy the artifact.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Control1.detail: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has long held %STATION_NAME%. Presumably, the station is built into some kind of system that allows quasimorphs to stay in physical reality. %VICTIM_NAME% has long been waging war against its quasimorphic enemies and is ready to attack %STATION_NAME%. Its target is the <color=#FFFEC1>reliquary</color>. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will be grateful to us if we protect it.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Control1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the reliquary</color> - a quasimorphic artifact similar to a statue or obelisk.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Defense1.after: The reward from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is already on Magnum. If we can hold off even %VICTIM_NAME%, does that mean we can destroy them? And is it worth doing this for the sake of other quasimorphs?
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Defense1.briefi: As soon as we get you there, the attack will begin. Sensors show that hostile quasimorphs have already appeared in certain areas of %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Hold out as long as possible</color>, their onslaught will certainly weaken.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Defense1.detail:
Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% needs our services. Their %STATION_NAME% is being attacked by %VICTIM_NAME%. Both groups of quasimorphs not only know how to linger in physical reality, but have also learned to bypass the SBN filters and constantly transmit messages to the network. Each faction considers itself the true master of the Solar System.

An attack on the station can begin at any moment, and if we want to improve relations with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, then we should hurry.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Elimination1.af: <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> is pleased with the result of our work. A gift for our obedience awaits in the Magnum's cargo hold.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Elimination1.br: We'll drop you off wherever we can. <color=#FFFEC1>Kill the Duke</color>. Don't try to be a hero and clear out the entire %STATION_NAME%. Don't take unnecessary risks, save your strength. I send the target location to your map. Good luck.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Elimination1.de: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Quasimorphs have captured %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> wants her enemies to be taught a lesson. <color=#FFFEC1>The Duke</color> of %VICTIM_NAME% is currently located in this location. They prepare the quasimorphs to attack the bases of the <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color>. Their <color=#FFFEC1>elimination</color> is a good way to please <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color>.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Escort1.after: The envoys of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% conveyed to us the praise of the <color=#FFFEC1>Duke</color> and called for the expansion of allied relations. If we work for the future winner now, we will take a worthy place in the future new hierarchy of the Solar System.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Escort1.briefin: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has called us for a specific purpose: <color=#FFFEC1>escort the Duke</color> to safety at %STATION_NAME%. Quasimorphs will send the best warriors into battle, so be careful.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Escort1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% is preparing to attack %STATION_NAME%. However, it has been turned into a real fortress by %BENEFICIARY_NAME%. The rightful owners of the Solar System will not give up so easily. And %VICTIM_NAME% understands this. It seems it is planning to eliminate the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME%.

The Quasimorphs call on their loyal servants to fulfill their sacred duty. If we want to strengthen relations with %BENEFICIARY_NAME%, we must take on the role of the Duke's personal guard.

We need to escort it to the safe location on the station and protect it from attacks by %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Escort1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the Duke of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% to the safe location.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Espionage1.afte: The meeting with the warriors of <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color> took place. We gave them the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>, they gave us a gift from <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color>.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Espionage1.brie:
The signature of the igvalite has been found, its location is marked on the map. We'll try to drop you off as close to the location as possible, but we can't promise anything: the shuttle pilot is already reporting strange visions.

Move through %STATION_NAME% carefully, save your strength. %VICTIM_NAME% will certainly defend the igvalite with special zeal.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Espionage1.deta:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% firmly holds %STATION_NAME%. Xiomara senses the presence of an extremely important thing there, which will help her in the fight for the Solar System.

The Warriors of the Feathered Masks told us that there is an igvalite on %STATION_NAME% - a mineral-like entity. It is able to accumulate gavvakh - energy that powers quasimorphs. If we want to serve Xiomara, we must get her this igvalite.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Espionage1.obje: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color> at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Infiltration1.a: The meeting with quasimorphs from %BENEFICIARY_NAME% took place. This is a good deal: a rock that is useless to us in exchange for something that actually works.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Infiltration1.b:
Several groups of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% have already infiltrated %STATION_NAME%. You need to find them and eliminate them before they take over the igvalite. %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is ready to give out a really good reward for this rock.

How did we even get into this, Boss?
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Infiltration1.d: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate all groups of quasimorphs who came for the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>.

Details: %BENEFICIARY_NAME% has held %STATION_NAME% for a long time. However, it is now under attack from %VICTIM_NAME%.

We have recognized the signature of an Igvalite coming from the station. It is a quasimorphic artifact capable of accumulating gavvakh. It seems that %BENEFICIARY_NAME% is using this place to store energy.

We can eliminate the groups of quasimorphs of %VICTIM_NAME% who have come for the igvalite. Let's do this, and the reward from the new owners of the Solar System will be extremely high.
mission.Xiomara_Tezctlan_Infiltration1.o: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate all groups of quasimorphs who came for the <color=#FFFEC1>igvalite</color>.
Servants of <color=#FFFEC1>Xiomara</color> are settling in at %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color> are pleased with our success. They transferred something extremely valuable to Magnum.

Proceed methodically, do not take unnecessary risks. Kill enough and the survivors will run. Upon completion of the mission, as soon as you leave the facility, Xiomara will send her duke.

Details: Xiomara has seriously taken up the task of establishing order in the Solar System. Now she is looking for anyone who will help the Feathered Masks capture %STATION_NAME% to continue the fight against Tezctlan.

%VICTIM_NAME% holds on to this metal piece of matter as if it were the greatest of treasures. Let's expel them from physical reality, and Xiomara will thank us.
